description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched

Choose one Glimpse belonging to an Aperture other than your own. You gain it, and you can use it once your level is at least one higher than its listed level — so a 1st-level Glimpse from 2nd, a 7th-level Glimpse from 8th, a 15th-level Glimpse from 16th. It costs Bandwidth and takes actions exactly as it does for a Warden of that Aperture, and it is declared Signal or Static like anything else.

cinderfall.incomplete: Choose any other Aperture's Glimpse; usable once your level exceeds its listed level by 1. Same `ChoiceSet`/`GrantItem` shape issue as `second-aperture`: buildable in principle, but needs a shared tag across all nine Glimpse cards (1st/7th/15th x three Apertures) to filter on, which doesn't exist today. Also inherits the Bandwidth cost of whichever Glimpse is chosen. No `SpecialResource` rule element exists anywhere in the corpus for Bandwidth -- confirmed corpus-wide (`grep -rl "\"key\": \"SpecialResource\"" site/data/cards/` returns zero hits), and the class card itself (`site/data/cards/classes/classes.paradise-touched.json:49`) ships `system.rules: []`. Same absence class as Cultist Zeal/Ironsight Drift/Fleshmancer Vitae.
